scope: Full-season in-sample bonus ordering; one selected DD model only; no training or test scoring
bonus_order: Saved bonus_difficulty_order.csv order, filtered to model
sampling_order: For each batch, draw all log-r coordinates, then all beta coordinates; arrays have shape (20000, batch bonuses, 3 parts, 3 dimensions).
approximation: Independent Normal beta and Normal log-r from saved mean-field AutoNormal quantiles; r = exp(log-r)
normal_parameters: mu = p500; sd = (p975-p025)/(2*scipy.stats.norm.ppf(0.975)); apply log to all r quantiles first
difficulty: D = sum_k r_k * beta_k, recomputed jointly for each part in every draw
point_gaps: Original D at saved parameter medians; medium-easy and hard-medium
order_probability: Fraction of draws with both gaps strictly positive; do not multiply marginal pair probabilities
attempts: Number of distinct response_id per bonus_id in saved fit predictions; three part rows count as one attempt
weighting: One vote per distinct fitted bonus within each reported subset; aggregate within question set as well as overall
limits: Conditional on the saved model, dataset, optimization run and frozen Stage-1 skills
Mean-field approximation omits parameter correlations; uncertainty is approximate
Attempt subsets reuse the full fit; no responses removed for training and no refitting
Differences by attempt count do not establish effects of collecting more data
attempt_band_boundaries: Inclusive integer counts: 1 through 9, 10 through 19, 20 through 29, and 30 or more.
